requirement.requiredInputs: Ice-strengthening status, construction date, equipment topology, and equivalent approval
requirement.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirement.sourceText: Ice-strengthened ships constructed on or after 1 January 2026 shall have either two independent echo-sounding devices or one echo-sounding device with two separate independent transducers. Other devices capable of depth sounding, such as fish finders, acceptable to the Administration, may be used as equivalent means of meeting this requirement.
